offline_vs_online_gap_note: Offline nDCG/MAP gains are reported alongside a real-outcome hire-capture proxy on the SAME held-out jobs. If the hire-capture delta is smaller or flips sign relative to the nDCG delta, the offline win should NOT be shipped without an online A/B test -- this is the exact failure mode the guide warns about ('nDCG going up offline means nothing if applications go down online').
